note: The official V16.2.0 binaries are now downloadable - sost-node, sost-miner, sost-cli and SHA256SUMS at github.com/Neob1844/sost-core/releases/tag/v16.2.0 - so compiling is optional for the first time in this upgrade cycle; a downloaded binary whose SHA256 matches is equally valid. The previous release stays downloadable at /releases/tag/v16.1.0 so a rollback does not depend on having kept a copy. The update window is unchanged and is the one to follow: install on your NODE AND your MINER after block #29,900 and before block #30,000, and restart both. Get the files and verify the hashes BEFORE the window opens. Consensus is unchanged - V16 still activates at #30,000 and the first DTD Jackpot V2 is still #30,186. If you build it yourself the build directory must be named 'build'; the source path does not matter.
